name: verify_identity_skill
description: Activate and exercise a newly persisted executable Skill belonging to the current Identity through the normal Agent permission and workspace boundary. This is the narrow verification bridge for governed evolution; it never grants arbitrary reads of the Identity directory.

skill_name.description: Exact snake_case name of a Skill stored under the current Identity.

cases.description: One or more acceptance cases. Each item has arguments and either expected_subset or expect_error_contains.
